data.narrative:
Brimstone is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Cody Finke and Hugo Leandri. The target operates within a comp universe of nine private frontier-tech peers and one public comparable (LNZA), though the broader Climate & Energy sector encompasses eight private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using the company's $100M+ total raised as a baseline proxy for enterprise value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent funding rounds yields an implied valuation of $200M. This method reflects observed progression patterns in capital-intensive frontier tech, where deployment of early capital and technical validation typically support a doubling of valuation at the next institutional round.

The peer-median approach is not applicable here. While eight same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, insufficient overlap was identified across same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier filters to support reliable triangulation (minimum three datapoints required). Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial noise given stage and capital-intensity variance.

Analysis supports a valuation range of $170M to $230M, with a median point of $200M. Key uncertainties center on stage-appropriate step-up multiples in frontier tech and the representativeness of total raised as an enterprise value proxy absent current revenue or asset backing.
